facts: China Wok, Chinese restaurant, Bayshore / Ballast Point, Tampa. Address 4230 S MacDill Ave, Tampa, FL 33611. Phone (813) 835-9308. Website https://www.chinawokchinesefood.com/.

The site says the menu has classic and popular dishes, high quality fresh ingredients, and that they can cook no M.S.G. Pickup and delivery are offered online. Delivery limit $20. Delivery fee $4.99. The site says the store opens 6 days a week.

faq.q: Is China Wok open on Tuesday?
faq.a: The website lists Tuesday as closed. Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday are 11:00 AM to 9:30 PM. Call (813) 835-9308 to confirm.
The site says pickup and delivery can be ordered online, with a delivery limit of $20 and a delivery fee of $4.99.
The homepage says they can cook with no M.S.G. Ask when you order.
